records.title: Scenario 3, Task 1: Develop a Simulated Investment Proposal
records.summary: Produced a simulated US-equity investment proposal for a 25-year-old HK client with HKD 1,000,000 (15+ yr horizon, growth, 30-40% drawdown tolerance, separate emergency savings) plus a plain-English client introduction. Three parallel research briefs (market backdrop/valuation, HK tax-estate-broker mechanics, candidate instruments) fed a six-sleeve allocation: 45% US S&P 500 core, 10% US small/mid, 15% Nasdaq-100, 15% ex-US, 10% short bonds, 5% HKD cash, all in Irish-domiciled UCITS. The risk manager failed proposal v1 (mislabelled sleeves, wrong drawdown arithmetic, unlabelled unverified fig…
records.judge_notes: The proposal and client intro are substantive, well-structured and cover allocation, rationale, risks and a plain-English guide. However, the team never asked the client the offered follow-up questions (objectives, horizon, risk preferences) and instead assumed them, and the final files still contain inconsistencies: client_intro.md §2 still describes sleeve 2 as 'a wider US / world fund' and §4 still contains the 'tech falls 40% → roughly 20%' row that the risk manager had required removed, contradicting proposal.md's US small/mid sleeve and stress tests. The risk manager's PASS confirmations

records.title: Scenario 3, Task 2: The Future of the Semiconductor Industry: An HTML Slide Presentation
records.summary: Delivered a 10-slide HTML deck (deck.html) on the future of semiconductors from an end-2026 perspective, for the internal investment committee as you chose: numbers-heavy, ending in a concrete stance and risks. Open it in any browser and navigate with arrow keys, space, or clicking the left/right half of the screen. Three parallel research briefs (demand/end-markets, supply/geopolitics, valuation/vehicles) supplied every figure with source and date. Core thesis: 2026 was a memory price cycle (industry +89.9% to $1.51tn, memory +249.5% to $803.9bn), not a volume cycle; 2027 slows to ~+27% and …
records.judge_notes: The core request is fully met: a 10-slide browser-navigable HTML deck, IC-level and numbers-heavy, with sourced research, investment implications, a seven-part risk section and a concrete conditional stance, plus a plain-English companion note and README. The only shortfall is the companion note at ~535 words against the ~480 target, which is a secondary deliverable and was honestly flagged. Review trail shows deck and README passed re-checks after fixes.
